input.name: Add App and Launch Demo Link
input.description: Adds a new app to the CAS Console with a given name, URL, and goal, then runs the built-in discovery agent against it to find and launch a "demo" link, waiting for the run to be recorded and returning the resulting capability name from the run report.

inputs.name: app_name
inputs.description: Friendly name for the new app (e.g. www.zazvata.com)

inputs.name: app_url
inputs.description: Starting URL for the new app (e.g. https://www.zazvata.com)

inputs.name: goal
inputs.description: Plain-English goal for the agent to accomplish on the app (e.g. 'Find a link for demo and launch it.')

outputs.name: capability_name
outputs.description: The name/version of the capability artifact recorded by the discovery run (e.g. 'launch-zaz-ui-demo v1')
